# Fuel
Some items can be used as [color=yellow]fuel[/color] for suitable things like a campfire or torch.
Different items provide different amounts of fuel and different burning temperatures. For example, sticks provide very little fuel and temperature compared to logs and coal.
# Consumption
Some things, as you may have guessed, consume fuel to keep burning. For them to work properly, you need to keep the fuel at a sufficient level.
If the fuel runs out, the thing will go out, but it can be used again if you add fuel and relight it.
# Extinguishing
You can extinguish a burning object with a shovel or with your hands if the object is small.
